# Capability index

<!-- Generated by scripts/capabilities.py — do not edit by hand. -->

Every public name in the stack (1032 of them), each listed once at
its public home, with the first line of its docstring. Search this page
before writing a helper: if what you need is here, compose it; if it is
almost here, extend it where it lives. Regenerate with
`make capabilities` after changing a public API (CI checks it is
current).

### `geoops.augment`

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AtmosphericHaze` | class | Add a sampled haze term following an inverse fourth-power spectrum. |
| `BandDropout` | class | Fill each band independently with probability ``p``. |
| `BandJitter` | class | Permute bands within explicitly configured groups. |
| `BrightnessJitter` | class | Scale reflectance values by a sampled scalar or per-band factor. |
| `Compose` | class | Apply augmentations sequentially behind a pipeline probability gate. |
| `ContrastJitter` | class | Scale deviations from the per-band spatial mean. |
| `CutMix` | class | Paste a random rectangle from a pool donor on the input's pixel grid. |
| `GaussianNoise` | class | Add zero-mean Gaussian sensor noise. |
| `RandomCrop` | class | Randomly crop a spatial window and update the transform. |
| `RandomFlip` | class | Randomly flip a GeoArray horizontally and/or vertically. |
| `RandomRotate90` | class | Randomly rotate by 90, 180, or 270 degrees. |
| `RandomShift` | class | Randomly shift a fixed-size spatial window in pixel units. |
| `SimulatedClouds` | class | Overlay a smooth synthetic cloud field onto reflectance imagery. |
| `SpeckleNoise` | class | Apply multiplicative Gaussian speckle noise, useful for SAR. |
| `SunAngleJitter` | class | Rescale TOA reflectance for a simulated solar-zenith change. |
| `cloud_alpha` | function | Cloud opacity map covering ``coverage`` of the pixels. |
| `rayleigh_weights` | function | Per-band inverse-fourth-power haze weights, peak-normalised. |
| `rot90_transform` | function | Compose ``transform`` with the pixel map of ``np.rot90(..., k)``. |
| `sun_angle_scale` | function | TOA-reflectance factor for a solar-zenith change. |

## Upstream: `pipekit`

The composition framework every operator subclasses. Use these
instead of writing your own control flow, caching, observation,
QC, parallel map or serialisation; a carrier-agnostic need belongs
upstream, not here.

| Name | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AssertCallable` | class | Pass-through; raise `QCError` if ``predicate(x)`` is falsy. |
| `AssertDType` | class | Pass-through; raise `QCError` if ``getattr(x, 'dtype')`` mismatches. |
| `AssertHasAttribute` | class | Pass-through; raise `QCError` if attribute missing (or value mismatches). |
| `AssertShape` | class | Pass-through; raise `QCError` if ``getattr(x, 'shape')`` mismatches. |
| `AsyncMap` | class | Apply ``op`` to each item of an iterable inside an async event loop. |
| `BackendError` | class | Inputs on more than one backend, or a backend the code does not run on. |
| `BatchedMap` | class | Split an iterable into batches and call ``op`` on each batch as a list. |
| `Branch` | class | Binary conditional: run ``if_true`` or ``if_false`` based on a predicate. |
| `Cache` | class | Memoise an inner operator by hashing its input and config. |
| `Carrier` | class | Re-exported from `typing`. |
| `CarryState` | class | Base class for state threaded through a stateful pipeline. |
| `Coalesce` | class | Try each source in order; return the first output that satisfies ``is_ok``. |
| `ConfigMixin` | class | Auto-derive `get_config()` from `__init__` parameter names. |
| `Const` | class | Return a fixed value, ignoring any input. |
| `Fanout` | class | Apply each named operator to the same input; return a dict of outputs. |
| `FittableTransformer` | class | Anything with sklearn-style ``fit`` + ``transform`` methods. |
| `Graph` | class | A symbolic operator graph with multiple inputs and outputs. |
| `Histogram` | class | Controller that captures simple histograms by key. |
| `Identity` | class | Explicit no-op. Returns its input unchanged. |
| `Input` | class | A named entry point into a `Graph`. |
| `Lambda` | class | Wrap an arbitrary callable as an `Operator`. |
| `Memoize` | class | Memoise an inner operator by hashing its input and config. |
| `MissingAdapterError` | class | A carrier from a known family arrived with no adapter registered. |
| `NamedArrayAdapter` | class | What carrier-agnostic code needs from one carrier family. |
| `Node` | class | A vertex in a `Graph`. |
| `Operator` | class | Base class for pipekit operators. |
| `Predictor` | class | Anything with a sklearn-style ``predict`` method. |
| `ProcessMap` | class | Apply ``op`` to each item of an iterable using a process pool. |
| `Profile` | class | Controller that records per-step wall-clock timings. |
| `QCError` | class | Raised when a QC assertion fails. Subclass of `AssertionError`. |
| `Quarantine` | class | Non-raising QC: on failure log and return ``sentinel``; on success pass through. |
| `Retry` | class | Retry an operator on transient failures with exponential backoff. |
| `Sequential` | class | Apply a list of operators in order, threading the output of each into the next. |
| `ShapeTrace` | class | Log ``shape`` / ``dtype`` of each carrier passing through. |
| `Signature` | class | Immutable shape + dtype record. |
| `Sink` | class | Apply a side-effecting write and pass the input through unchanged. |
| `Snapshot` | class | Controller that captures intermediate carriers by name. |
| `StatefulOperator` | class | Marker base for operators whose ``_apply`` threads carry-state. |
| `Switch` | class | Multi-way dispatch on ``key(carrier)``. |
| `Tap` | class | Fire a callback on the carrier; return the carrier unchanged. |
| `ThreadMap` | class | Apply ``op`` to each item of an iterable using a thread pool. |
| `Try` | class | Run ``primary``; on caught exceptions run ``fallback``. |
| `allowed` | function | Return the registered class names (``"module.Class"`` keys). |
| `backend_name` | function | ``"jax"``, ``"dask"`` or ``"numpy"`` for raw data (tracers count as JAX). |
| `backend_of` | function | The backend of a carrier or a raw array; ``None`` for any other value. |
| `check_pickleable` | function | Return the list of `forbid_in_yaml`-flagged operators inside ``op``. |
| `complement` | function | Return a predicate that negates ``predicate``. |
| `compose` | function | Right-to-left composition (mathematical order). |
| `compose_left` | function | Left-to-right composition (pipeline order). |
| `compute_output_signature` | function | Free-function dispatch to ``op.compute_output_signature``. |
| `dumps` | function | JSON-encode an operator's state record. |
| `from_state_sandboxed` | function | Build an operator tree from a state record, allowlisted classes only. |
| `get_adapter` | function | The adapter for ``x``'s type, or ``None`` for an unnamed value. |
| `juxt` | function | Return a callable that applies each operator to its input and tuples the results. |
| `loads` | function | Decode an operator from its JSON state record. |
| `loads_sandboxed` | function | Like `loads`, but reject any class, at any depth, not in the allowlist. |
| `on_import` | function | Call ``callback(module)`` once ``name`` is imported, without importing it. |
| `pipe` | function | Apply ``operators`` left-to-right to ``value``. |
| `pipeline_hash` | function | Content hash of a pipeline's whole configuration, and optional weights. |
| `register` | function | Register ``cls`` as loadable via `loads_sandboxed`. |
| `register_adapter` | function | Register ``adapter`` for ``carrier_type`` and its subclasses. |
| `register_lazy_adapter` | function | Register ``loader`` for carrier types defined under ``module_prefix``. |
| `signature_of` | function | ``x``'s `Signature` if it is a registered carrier; ``x`` itself otherwise. |
| `unregister` | function | Remove ``cls`` from the sandboxed loader's allowlist. |
| `unregister_adapter` | function | Remove the adapter registered for exactly ``carrier_type``, if any. |

## Shared private toolkits

Not public API — the plumbing a package's own families and readers
share. Contributors use these instead of writing new helpers; a missing
helper is added here, not inline in one caller.

### `geoops._src`

| Module | Purpose | Helpers |
|---|---|---|
| `geoops._src.bands` | Shared utilities for resolving band references against GeoArray metadata. | `band_count`, `per_band_values`, `strip_band_attrs`, `take_band_coords`, `take_band_attrs`, `concat_band_attrs`, `band_names`, `resolve_band`, `resolve_bands`, `resolve_wavelengths` |
| `geoops._src.blending` | Shared overlap-add blending primitives. | `triangular_weights`, `overlap_add`, `normalize_overlap_add` |
| `geoops._src.config` | Shared ``get_config()`` coercion helpers. | `jsonable`, `as_tuple`, `mapping_to_pairs`, `mapping_from_pairs`, `reject_config_summary` |
| `geoops._src.contract` | The pipekit `Operator` and `GeoArray` carrier contracts, as assertions. | `geoarrays`, `is_nested_operator`, `same`, `assert_keyword_only`, `assert_config_round_trips`, `assert_graph_mode`, `assert_same_carrier`, `assert_consistent_attrs`, `assert_fill_matches_dtype`, `assert_rejects_geotensor`, `assert_clear_rank_error`, `time_stack_of`, `time_series_of`, `frames`, `assert_time_stack`, `assert_backends` |
| `geoops._src.dtype` | Shared dtype primitives: float promotion and fills a dtype can hold. | `as_float`, `holds_fill`, `fill_for` |
| `geoops._src.engine` | The georeader engine boundary: geotoolz carriers in, georeader out, and back. | `to_engine`, `from_engine` |
| `geoops._src.fitted` | Shared plumbing for fitted operators (the ``fit`` / ``transform`` seam). | `PicklableLock`, `fit_lock`, `fit_once` |
| `geoops._src.geo` | Shared georeferencing helpers. | `is_georeader_object`, `reject_georeader`, `affine_of`, `as_pixel_window`, `require_geoarray`, `require_projected_crs`, `ground_pixel_size`, `grid_matches`, `require_grid_match`, `pixel_xy` |
| `geoops._src.geotensor` | Refusing a georeader ``GeoTensor``, without importing georeader or geoarray. | `is_geotensor`, `reject_geotensor` |
| `geoops._src.kernels` | Kernel operators: one element-wise L1 kernel, run on every carrier. | `named`, `select_band`, `nodata_where`, `band_kernel`, `carrier_kernel`, `mask_kernel`, `pixel_kernel` |
| `geoops._src.labels` | Shared connected-component, hole, skeleton and region-property primitives. | `connectivity_structure`, `label_components`, `remove_small_holes`, `skeleton_length`, `regionprops_frame` |
| `geoops._src.optional` | Lazy import of optional-extra dependencies with an actionable error. | `import_optional`, `optional_root`, `optional_name` |
| `geoops._src.samples` | Shared pixel flattening: ``(c, h, w)`` cubes <-> ``(n, c)`` sample matrices. | `SampleLayout`, `cube_to_samples`, `samples_to_cube`, `sample_layout` |
| `geoops._src.shape` | Shared shape-normalisation primitives. | `band_axis`, `band_dim`, `dim_axis`, `require_ndim`, `keep_band_axis`, `map_frames`, `over_frames`, `single_band`, `gather_inputs` |
| `geoops._src.stretch` | Shared percentile clip-and-stretch core. | `check_percentiles`, `stretch_between`, `percentile_stretch` |
| `geoops._src.valid` | Shared notion of an *invalid* (nodata) pixel. | `carrier_fill_value`, `is_fill`, `invalid_values`, `valid_pixels`, `mask_invalid_to_nan`, `restore_fill`, `carried_fill`, `wrap_filled`, `namespace_of`, `invalid_elements`, `fill_of`, `invalid_pixel_mask` |
| `geoops._src.wrap` | Carrier rewrap discipline shared by every operator family. | `Inherit`, `rewrap_attrs`, `adopt_attrs`, `wrap_like`, `rewrap_dims` |
